name: ComfyArt (open-source local AI design canvas for ComfyUI)
summary: MIT-licensed infinite design canvas (tldraw + React) that installs as a ComfyUI custom node: image/video generation and editing, mockups, Edit Elements (poster to editable layers), music, voiceover, SFX and image-to-3D, all running as local ComfyUI workflows, plus an MCP design agent usable from Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or a local LLM. No account or credits needed locally.

access.price: $0 local; optional Comfy Cloud mode needs a paid Comfy plan
access.notes: Local use needs a capable GPU and the listed ComfyUI models (each under its own license). Agent needs your own Claude Code/Codex/Qwen login or a local LLM.

procedure: pip install -r requirements.txt in ComfyUI's environment; restart ComfyUI.
Click ComfyArt in the top bar or open http://127.0.0.1:8188/comfyart/; download the models listed in the README workflows table.

verdict.why: Real, actively developed MIT tool (390 GitHub stars) bringing a Lovart-style creative canvas fully local on ComfyUI, covering image, video, audio and 3D. Paid only if you opt into Comfy Cloud.
